system.description:
Troubadours claim that you outpace lightning itself, a streak of motion no eye can hold.

By expending a Blood Trait, in addition to the benefits of Fleetness, you gain a fourth action, which takes place after the actions of all vampires using Legerity. This action may be used only for physical feats, never Mental or Social Disciplines. Celerity draws no retest from any Ability, though each action may be retested by its own Ability, and a surprised character cannot use Celerity on the first challenge. The effect lasts one turn.
